title: Homily

inlines.v: HOM'ILY, noun [Gr. to converse in company, a company or assembly.] A discourse or sermon read or pronounced to an audience; or a plain, familiar discourse on some subject of religion, such as an instructor would deliver to his pupils, or a father to his children.
